facts.fact: Universal Ads launched the Incrementality Fund, an initiative designed to help e-commerce businesses, especially Shopify Plus merchants, use TV advertising to grow their brands.
facts.quote: Today, we’re thrilled to announce the launch of the [**Incrementality Fund**](http://incrementalityfund.com/)—a new initiative designed to help e-commerce businesses, especially Shopify Plus merchants

facts.fact: Under the Universal Ads Incrementality Fund, qualifying merchants can receive up to $50,000 in ad credits and services to launch their first or next TV campaign.
facts.quote: qualifying merchants can receive up to **$50,000 in ad credits and services** to launch their first (or next) TV campaign.

facts.fact: Universal Ads states that its TV advertising inventory can potentially reach over 90% of U.S. households (vendor claim).
facts.quote: We can potentially reach over **90% of U.S. households**, and now we’re helping scaling businesses tap into that audience.

facts.fact: Universal Ads says its premium inventory is connected to publishers including NBCUniversal, Warner Bros. Discovery, and Fox.
facts.quote: connected to the same premium inventory from top publishers—NBCUniversal, Warner Bros. Discovery, Fox, and more

facts.fact: Fund recipients receive ad credits to run targeted, measurable TV campaigns.
facts.quote: **Ad credits:** to run targeted, measurable TV campaigns.

facts.fact: Fund recipients receive free creative production to turn brand assets into TV spots using AI.
facts.quote: **Free creative production**: to help you turn your brand assets into high-performing TV spots using AI.

facts.fact: Fund recipients receive incrementality measurement to prove the real impact of their campaign.
facts.quote: **Incrementality measurement:** to prove the real impact of your campaign on your business.

facts.fact: Fund recipients receive VIP access to Universal Ads' fall summit in New York.
facts.quote: **VIP access:**to Universal Ad’s fall summit in New York.

facts.fact: Eligible applicants are Shopify Plus merchants or growing e-commerce brands ready to explore TV advertising.
facts.quote: If you’re a Shopify Plus merchant or a growing e-commerce brand ready to explore the power of TV, we want to hear from you.

facts.fact: Applicants apply for the Incrementality Fund via IncrementalityFund.com.
facts.quote: Visit [IncrementalityFund.com](http://incrementalityfund.com/) to learn more and apply.
